q.en: Someone touched me and it felt bad. What should I do?
q.hg: Kisi ne mujhe touch kiya aur mujhe bura laga. Main kya karun?

a.en: Tell a grown-up you trust, like Mummy, Papa or your teacher, as soon as you can. Say what happened in your own words. You did nothing wrong, and you will not be in trouble. If that grown-up does not help, tell another one. A grown-up can also call 1098 for help.
a.hg: Jitni jaldi ho sake kisi trusted bade ko batao, jaise Mummy, Papa ya teacher. Jo hua, apne words mein bata do. Tumne kuch galat nahi kiya, aur tumhe daant nahi padegi. Agar woh bada help na kare, toh kisi doosre ko batao. Koi bada help ke liye 1098 par call bhi kar sakta hai.

q.en: A grown-up told me to keep a secret and said I will get into trouble if I tell. Should I tell?
q.hg: Ek bade ne mujhse secret rakhne ko bola aur kaha ki bataya toh mujhe daant padegi. Kya mujhe batana chahiye?

a.en: Yes, tell. A secret that makes you scared or sad is an unsafe secret. A grown-up who says 'you will get into trouble' is trying to trick you. You will not be in trouble. Go to a grown-up you trust and say, 'Someone asked me to keep a secret and I don't like it.'
a.hg: Haan, batao. Jo secret tumhe daraye ya sad kare, woh unsafe secret hai. Jo bada bolta hai 'tumhe daant padegi', woh tumhe trick kar raha hai. Tumhe daant nahi padegi. Kisi trusted bade ke paas jao aur bolo, 'Kisi ne mujhse ek secret rakhne ko bola hai aur mujhe achha nahi lag raha.'

q.en: Children in my class tease me every day. Is something wrong with me?
q.hg: Meri class ke bachche mujhe roz chidhate hain. Kya mujhme koi kami hai?

a.en: No. Nothing is wrong with you. When someone hurts or teases you again and again, it is called bullying. It is their wrong choice, not your fault. Stay near friends, say 'Stop' in a strong voice and walk away. Then tell your teacher and someone at home. If it does not stop, tell them again. Fixing this is the grown-ups' job, not yours alone.
a.hg: Nahi. Tumme koi kami nahi hai. Jab koi tumhe baar-baar hurt kare ya chidhaye, toh use bullying kehte hain. Yeh unki galat choice hai, tumhari galti nahi. Doston ke paas raho, strong awaaz mein 'Stop' bolo aur wahan se chale jao. Phir apni teacher ko aur ghar par kisi ko batao. Agar yeh na ruke, toh phir batao. Ise theek karna bado ka kaam hai, akele tumhara nahi.

q.en: A bhaiya in my colony gives me gifts and says not to tell Mummy. Is that okay?
q.hg: Colony ke ek bhaiya mujhe gifts dete hain aur bolte hain Mummy ko mat batana. Kya yeh theek hai?

a.en: No, that is a warning sign. Kind adults and older kids do not need secrets from your parents. Gifts plus 'don't tell' is a common way tricky people build trust before asking for something that is not okay. You have done nothing wrong by taking the gifts. Tell your mother, father or another trusted adult about the gifts and the secret today, and do not go anywhere alone with him. If you cannot tell anyone at home, call 1098.
a.hg: Nahi, yeh warning sign hai. Achhe adults aur bade bachchon ko tumhare parents se kuch chhupane ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Gifts plus 'kisi ko mat batana', yeh tricky logon ka trust banane ka common tareeka hai, jiske baad woh kuch aisa maangte hain jo okay nahi hota. Gifts lekar tumne kuch galat nahi kiya. Aaj hi apni Mummy, Papa ya kisi aur trusted adult ko gifts aur secret wali baat batao, aur uske saath akele kahin mat jao. Agar ghar par kisi ko nahi bata sakte, toh 1098 par call karo.

q.en: I told an adult what happened and they did not believe me. What now?
q.hg: Maine ek adult ko bataya ki kya hua, par unhone mera yakeen nahi kiya. Ab kya karun?

a.en: Tell someone else. Some adults react badly because they are shocked, scared or trust the other person; that does not make what you said any less true. Choose another trusted adult: a different relative, a teacher, the school counsellor or a friend's parent. You can also call Child Helpline 1098, which is free and open day and night, and the people there are trained to listen to children. If speaking is hard, write down what happened and hand over the note. Keep telling until someone acts. Not being believed is the adult's failure, never yours.
a.hg: Kisi aur ko batao. Kuch adults isliye bura react karte hain ki woh shock mein hote hain, dare hote hain ya saamne wale par trust karte hain; isse tumhari baat zara bhi kam sach nahi ho jaati. Koi doosra trusted adult chuno: koi aur rishtedaar, teacher, school counsellor ya dost ke parents. Tum Child Helpline 1098 par bhi call kar sakte ho, jo free hai aur din-raat khuli hai, aur wahan ke log bachchon ki baat sunne ke liye trained hain. Agar bolna mushkil ho, toh jo hua use likhkar note de do. Tab tak batate raho jab tak koi action na le. Yakeen na kiya jaana us adult ka failure hai, tumhara kabhi nahi.

q.en: Boys pass comments on my body when I walk to tuition. Everyone says to ignore it because it's 'just teasing'. Is it?
q.hg: Tuition jaate time ladke meri body par comments paas karte hain. Sab bolte hain ignore karo, yeh 'bas chhed-chhaad' hai. Kya sach mein?

a.en: It is sexual harassment, not teasing. Unwanted sexual comments, whistling, staring and following are offences in India, and they are not caused by your clothes, your route or your body. Ignoring is one way to stay safe in the moment, but you do not have to carry it silently. Tell a parent or teacher, walk with others where you can, note the place and time, and call 112 if you feel unsafe or someone follows you. Wanting it to stop is not overreacting.
a.hg: Yeh sexual harassment hai, teasing nahi. Unwanted sexual comments, seeti bajana, ghoorna aur follow karna India mein offences hain, aur inki wajah tumhare kapde, tumhara route ya tumhari body nahi hai. Us moment mein ignore karna safe rehne ka ek tareeka hai, lekin tumhe ise chupchaap jhelte rehne ki zaroorat nahi. Parents ya teacher ko batao, jahan ho sake auron ke saath chalo, jagah aur time note karo, aur agar unsafe lage ya koi follow kare toh 112 par call karo. Yeh chahna ki yeh ruke, overreact karna nahi hai.

q.en: Someone keeps following me and messaging from new accounts after I blocked them. Is this stalking?
q.hg: Block karne ke baad bhi koi mujhe follow karta hai aur naye accounts se message karta hai. Kya yeh stalking hai?

a.en: Yes. Repeatedly following or contacting someone who has clearly shown they are not interested is stalking, and it is an offence in India, online as well as offline. It is not proof of love. Do not agree to 'one last meeting'. Keep screenshots, call logs and account names, tell a trusted adult, and report it: 112 if you feel in danger, 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in for online stalking, or the police with an adult. Tell your school and close friends so that they do not share where you are.
a.hg: Haan. Jisne clearly dikha diya ho ki use interest nahi hai, use baar-baar follow karna ya contact karna stalking hai, aur yeh India mein offence hai, online bhi aur offline bhi. Yeh pyaar ka proof nahi hai. 'Bas ek last baar mil lo' wali baat mat maano. Screenshots, call logs aur account names sambhalkar rakho, kisi trusted adult ko batao, aur report karo: danger lage toh 112, online stalking ke liye 1930 ya cybercrime.gov.in, ya kisi adult ke saath police. Apne school aur close friends ko bata do taaki woh kisi ko na batayein ki tum kahan ho.

q.en: If I tell a doctor or counsellor about abuse, will they tell my parents or the police?
q.hg: Agar main doctor ya counsellor ko abuse ke baare mein bataun, toh kya woh mere parents ya police ko bata denge?

a.en: It depends on your age and what you share. If you are under 18 and tell them about sexual abuse or sexual activity, the POCSO Act requires them to inform the police, so they cannot promise total secrecy. A parent or guardian is usually involved too; if the person harming you is family, say so, so another safe adult can help. Reporting aims to stop the abuse, not punish you, and your identity is protected. At 18 or older, counsellors generally keep things confidential, but a hospital treating rape must inform the police; you still decide whether to file a complaint. Unsure? Ask first, or call 1098.
a.hg: Yeh tumhari age par aur is par depend karta hai ki tum kya share karte ho. Agar tum 18 se kam ho aur unhe sexual abuse ya sexual activity ke baare mein batate ho, toh POCSO Act ke under unhe police ko inform karna hota hai, isliye woh total secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte. Usually parents ya guardian ko bhi involve kiya jaata hai; agar tumhe harm karne wala insaan family ka hai, toh yeh zaroor batao, taaki kisi doosre safe adult ko saath liya jaye. Reporting ka maqsad abuse rokna hai, tumhe saza dena nahi, aur tumhari identity protected rehti hai. 18 ya usse zyada age mein counsellors generally baat confidential rakhte hain, lekin rape ka treatment karne wale hospital ko police ko inform karna hota hai; complaint file karni hai ya nahi, yeh decision phir bhi tumhara hai. Sure nahi ho? Pehle pooch lo, ya 1098 par call karo.

q.en: My partner checks my phone, chooses my clothes and gets angry when I meet friends. They say it's because they love me. Is this abuse?
q.hg: Mera partner mera phone check karta hai, mere kapde decide karta hai aur friends se milne par gussa hota hai. Bolta hai yeh pyaar hai. Kya yeh abuse hai?

a.en: Those are signs of controlling behaviour, which is a form of emotional abuse even when there is no hitting. Love does not need your passwords, your isolation or your fear. Notice the pattern: do you change what you do to avoid their anger, and has your circle of friends shrunk? You do not have to decide everything today. Talk to a trusted adult or friend, keep one account and some money that they cannot access, and know the helplines: 1098 if you are under 18, 181 for women, 112 in danger and 14416 for emotional support. Control tends to grow with time, not fade.
a.hg: Yeh controlling behaviour ke signs hain, jo emotional abuse ka hi ek form hai, chahe maar-peet na ho. Pyaar ko aapke passwords, aapke isolation ya aapke darr ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Pattern notice karo: kya aap unke gusse se bachne ke liye apna behaviour badalte ho, aur kya aapka friend circle chhota ho gaya hai? Aapko aaj hi sab kuch decide nahi karna hai. Kisi trusted adult ya friend se baat karo, ek account aur kuch paise aise rakho jin tak unki access na ho, aur helplines yaad rakho: 18 se kam ho toh 1098, women ke liye 181, danger mein 112 aur emotional support ke liye 14416. Aisa control time ke saath kam nahi hota, badhta hai.

q.en: What should someone do in the first few hours after a sexual assault?
q.hg: Sexual assault ke baad pehle kuch ghanton mein kya karna chahiye?

a.en: First get to a safe place and, if in danger, call 112. Then get medical care as early as possible, even without visible injuries: medicine to prevent HIV must start within 72 hours and emergency contraception works up to 5 days. Hospitals must treat survivors free of charge and are required to inform the police; for anyone under 18, reporting is mandatory. If possible, avoid bathing or changing clothes before the examination, but go even if you already have. Take a trusted person along. Whatever was done, it was not the survivor's fault, and help remains available later too.
a.hg: Sabse pehle kisi safe jagah pahuncho aur danger ho toh 112 par call karo. Phir jitni jaldi ho sake medical care lo, chahe koi injury dikhe na: HIV se bachav ki medicine 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai aur emergency contraception 5 din tak kaam karta hai. Hospitals ko survivors ka treatment free karna hota hai aur police ko inform karna hota hai; 18 se kam umar walon ke case mein reporting mandatory hai. Ho sake toh examination se pehle na nahao aur kapde na badlo, lekin agar aisa kar chuke ho tab bhi zaroor jao. Kisi trusted insaan ko saath le jao. Jo bhi hua, usme survivor ki koi galti nahi thi, aur help baad mein bhi milti hai.

q.en: I didn't scream or push them away. Does that mean it was my fault?
q.hg: Maine na shor machaya, na use dhakka diya. Kya iska matlab galti meri thi?

a.en: No. Freezing, going silent or going along to stay safe are common automatic reactions when the brain senses danger; they are not choices and they are not consent. Many people also stay in touch with the person afterwards, or cannot remember things in order. None of that changes who was responsible: the person who did it. You do not have to tell everything to anyone before you are ready, but you deserve support. A trusted adult, a counsellor, 1098 if you are under 18, or Tele-MANAS on 14416 can help you carry this.
a.hg: Nahi. Freeze ho jaana, chup ho jaana ya safe rehne ke liye saath dete jaana, yeh sab common reactions hain jo dimaag danger sense karte hi automatically karta hai; yeh na tumhari choice hain, na consent. Bahut se log baad mein bhi us insaan ke contact mein rehte hain, ya cheezein order mein yaad nahi kar paate. Inme se kuch bhi yeh nahi badalta ki responsible kaun tha: wahi jisne aisa kiya. Jab tak tum ready na ho, kisi ko sab kuch batana zaroori nahi, lekin support milna tumhara haq hai. Koi trusted adult, counsellor, 18 se kam ho toh 1098, ya Tele-MANAS 14416 is bojh ko uthane mein tumhari help kar sakte hain.

q.en: My father hits my mother at home. What can I do?
q.hg: Ghar par Papa Mummy ko maarte hain. Main kya karun?

a.en: First, it is not your fault and it is not your job to stop it. During a fight, do not get in between; go to a safer room or a neighbour's home, and call 112 if someone could be badly hurt. Later, tell an adult you trust, such as a relative, teacher or school counsellor. You can call 1098 yourself, and your mother can call 181 for help with protection, shelter and legal options. Living with violence can cause fear, anger and trouble sleeping or studying, and talking to a counsellor helps.
a.hg: Sabse pehle, yeh tumhari galti nahi hai aur ise rokna tumhari responsibility nahi hai. Jhagde ke time beech mein mat aao; kisi zyada safe room ya padosi ke ghar chale jao, aur agar kisi ko serious chot lag sakti ho toh 112 par call karo. Baad mein kisi trusted adult ko batao, jaise koi rishtedaar, teacher ya school counsellor. Tum khud 1098 par call kar sakte ho, aur tumhari Mummy protection, shelter aur legal options ke liye 181 par call kar sakti hain. Violence ke beech rehne se darr, gussa, neend aur padhai mein dikkat ho sakti hai, aur counsellor se baat karne se help milti hai.

q.en: My family has fixed my marriage and says I have no choice. I don't want it. What can I do?
q.hg: Meri family ne meri shaadi fix kar di hai aur kehte hain ki mere paas koi choice nahi hai. Mujhe yeh shaadi nahi karni. Main kya karun?

a.en: You have the right to refuse. A marriage needs the free consent of both people, and consent obtained by force or fraud can be a ground for a court to cancel a marriage, within strict time limits. If you are under 18 (or a man under 21), the marriage itself is illegal: call 1098, and it can be stopped. If you are an adult, tell one trusted person outside the household, keep your ID, phone and some money within reach, and call 181 or 112 if you are being confined, threatened or taken somewhere against your will. Free legal aid is on 15100. This is general information, not legal advice.
a.hg: Tumhe mana karne ka right hai. Shaadi ke liye dono logon ki free consent zaroori hai, aur zabardasti ya dhokhe se li gayi consent ke ground par court shaadi cancel kar sakti hai, lekin iski time limit strict hai. Agar tum 18 se kam ho (ya 21 se kam umar ke man ho), toh yeh shaadi hi illegal hai: 1098 par call karo, ise rukwaya ja sakta hai. Agar tum adult ho, toh ghar ke bahar ke kisi ek trusted insaan ko batao, apna ID, phone aur kuch paise apni reach mein rakho, aur agar tumhe band karke rakha ja raha hai, dhamkaya ja raha hai ya tumhari marzi ke khilaaf kahin le jaya ja raha hai toh 181 ya 112 par call karo. Free legal aid 15100 par milti hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

keywords: ghar wale shaadi karwa rahe hain

q.en: My sister's in-laws keep demanding money from our parents, and she says they hit her. What can our family do?
q.hg: Meri behen ke sasural wale hamare parents se baar-baar paise maangte hain, aur woh kehti hai ki woh use maarte hain. Hamari family kya kar sakti hai?

a.en: Take it seriously and act; do not send her back with advice to 'adjust'. Demanding dowry is illegal, and cruelty to a married woman by her husband or his relatives is a criminal offence. Tell her plainly that she can come home and that her safety matters more than what people will say. Keep a record of demands, messages, injuries and dates. In danger, call 112. She can call 181, go to a One Stop Centre or approach the police, and a Protection Officer can help her seek a court's protection order. Free legal aid is on 15100. This is general information, not legal advice.
a.hg: Ise seriously lo aur action lo; use 'adjust' karne ki advice dekar wapas mat bhejo. Dahej maangna illegal hai, aur married woman ke saath uske husband ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty ek criminal offence hai. Use saaf bolo ki woh ghar aa sakti hai aur uski safety is baat se zyada important hai ki log kya kahenge. Demands, messages, injuries aur dates ka record rakho. Danger ho toh 112 par call karo. Woh 181 par call kar sakti hai, One Stop Centre ja sakti hai ya police ke paas ja sakti hai, aur Protection Officer court se protection order lene mein uski help kar sakta hai. Free legal aid 15100 par milti hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

keywords: sasural wale paise maang rahe hain

q.en: My partner and I are from different castes and our families are threatening us. How do we stay safe?
q.hg: Main aur mera partner alag-alag caste ke hain aur hamari families hume dhamka rahi hain. Hum safe kaise rahein?

a.en: The threat is the crime, not your relationship. The Supreme Court has said two adults may choose each other without family or community approval, and that police must protect threatened couples. If you fear violence, call 112 and give a written request for protection to the district police chief; couples can also approach the High Court. Keep proof of age and ID, share your location with a trusted friend, and get free legal advice on 15100. Marriage is legal only from 18 for women and 21 for men. If either of you is under 18, call 1098. Nobody may harm or confine you. This is general information, not legal advice.
a.hg: Crime dhamki hai, tumhara relationship nahi. Supreme Court keh chuka hai ki do adults family ya community ki approval ke bina ek-doosre ko choose kar sakte hain, aur jin couples ko dhamki mil rahi ho unhe police ko protect karna chahiye. Agar violence ka darr hai, toh 112 par call karo aur district ke police chief ko protection ke liye written request do; couples High Court se bhi protection maang sakte hain. Age proof aur ID apne paas rakho, kisi trusted friend ke saath apni location share karo, aur 15100 par free legal advice lo. Shaadi legally women ke liye 18 aur men ke liye 21 saal se hi ho sakti hai. Agar tum dono mein se koi 18 se kam hai, toh 1098 par call karo. Kisi ko bhi tumhe hurt karne ya band karke rakhne ka haq nahi hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

keywords: ghar wale dhamki de rahe hain

q.en: I'm a guy, and someone did something sexual to me that I didn't want. Does it even count? Who would believe me?
q.hg: Main ladka hoon, aur kisi ne mere saath kuch sexual kiya jo main nahi chahta tha. Kya yeh count bhi hota hai? Meri baat par kaun believe karega?

a.en: Yes, it counts. Any sexual act done without your consent is sexual violence, whatever your gender or size and even if you froze, and it was not your fault. Many men feel exactly this doubt, because nobody talks about it. You deserve care: a doctor can check for injuries and infections, and if it happened within the last 72 hours, ask urgently about HIV prevention medicine. If you are under 18, POCSO protects you fully; call 1098. If you are an adult, the law is weaker but other offences can apply, and 15100 gives free legal advice. For the weight of it, call 14416 or tell one person you trust.
a.hg: Haan, yeh count hota hai. Tumhari consent ke bina kiya gaya koi bhi sexual act sexual violence hai, tumhara gender ya size chahe jo ho aur tum chahe freeze ho gaye ho, aur isme tumhari koi galti nahi thi. Bahut se men ko exactly yahi doubt hota hai, kyunki is baare mein koi baat nahi karta. Tum care deserve karte ho: doctor injuries aur infections check kar sakta hai, aur agar yeh last 72 ghanton ke andar hua hai toh turant HIV prevention medicine ke baare mein poocho. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh POCSO tumhe poori tarah protect karta hai; 1098 par call karo. Agar tum adult ho, toh law kamzor hai par doosre offences apply ho sakte hain, aur 15100 par free legal advice milti hai. Mann ke bojh ke liye 14416 par call karo ya kisi ek trusted insaan ko batao.

q.en: My body reacted when it happened. I got an erection. Does that mean I wanted it?
q.hg: Jab yeh hua tab meri body ne react kiya, mujhe erection hua. Kya iska matlab hai ki main yeh chahta tha?

a.en: No. An erection, and even ejaculation, is a reflex controlled by nerves and blood flow, not by choice. It can be triggered by touch, fear or stress, the same way a knee jerks or eyes water. It does not mean you consented, enjoyed it or are responsible. People who abuse often point to this reaction on purpose, to make a boy feel he 'took part' and keep him quiet. Feeling confused or ashamed about it is very common among survivors, and it is one of the main reasons men stay silent. A counsellor or doctor has heard this before; you can say it to them. Tele-MANAS is on 14416.
a.hg: Nahi. Erection, aur ejaculation bhi, ek reflex hai jo nerves aur blood flow se control hota hai, tumhari choice se nahi. Yeh touch, darr ya stress se trigger ho sakta hai, bilkul waise jaise ghutna jhatka khata hai ya aankhon mein paani aa jaata hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki tumne consent di, tumhe achha laga ya tum responsible ho. Abuse karne wale aksar jaan-boojhkar isi reaction ki taraf point karte hain, taaki ladke ko lage ki woh bhi 'shaamil' tha aur woh chup rahe. Is baare mein confused ya ashamed feel karna survivors mein bahut common hai, aur men ke chup rehne ka yeh ek bada reason hai. Counsellor ya doctor yeh pehle bhi sun chuke hain; tum unse yeh baat khulkar bol sakte ho. Tele-MANAS 14416 par hai.

keywords: khada ho gaya tha kya meri galti

q.en: When I was 15, an older woman did sexual things with me. My friends say I got lucky. Why do I feel bad about it?
q.hg: Jab main 15 ka tha, ek older woman ne mere saath sexual cheezein ki. Mere friends kehte hain main lucky tha. Phir mujhe bura kyun lagta hai?

a.en: Because what happened was abuse, and your feelings are responding to that, not to your friends' version of it. A person under 18 cannot legally consent to sexual activity, and POCSO applies whether the adult is a man or a woman. An adult who uses a teenager sexually is misusing age and power, however it was presented at the time. Boys are taught to treat this as a prize, which leaves many of them confused, ashamed or numb for years. You do not have to laugh along. A counsellor, a doctor or 14416 can help you make sense of it; if you are still under 18, so can 1098.
a.hg: Kyunki jo hua woh abuse tha, aur tumhari feelings usi ko respond kar rahi hain, tumhare friends ke version ko nahi. 18 se kam umar ka insaan legally sexual activity ke liye consent nahi de sakta, aur POCSO tab bhi apply hota hai jab adult woman ho aur tab bhi jab man ho. Jo adult kisi teenager ko sexually use karta hai woh apni age aur power ka misuse kar raha hai, us time use chahe jaise present kiya gaya ho. Ladkon ko ise prize maanna sikhaya jaata hai, isi wajah se bahut se ladke saalon tak confused, ashamed ya numb rehte hain. Tumhe saath mein hansne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Counsellor, doctor ya 14416 se baat karne par ise samajhne mein help mil sakti hai; agar tum abhi bhi 18 se kam ho, toh 1098 bhi help kar sakta hai.

keywords: teacher ne ladke ke saath galat kiya

q.en: I think my drink was spiked last night. I can't remember parts of the evening. What should I do now?
q.hg: Mujhe lagta hai kal raat meri drink spike hui thi. Mujhe evening ke kuch parts yaad nahi hain. Ab main kya karun?

a.en: Treat it as a medical matter today. Tell someone you trust and go to a hospital or doctor. Say you suspect spiking, as some substances are detectable only briefly. If there is any chance of sexual contact, ask about emergency contraception (up to 5 days), HIV prevention medicine (must start within 72 hours) and testing for infections. If you can, keep the clothes you wore unwashed. Spiking is a crime whoever it is done to. Sex with a woman too intoxicated to consent is rape in law; for men the law is weaker. Report to the police or 112, or 181 for women. None of this is your fault.
a.hg: Ise aaj hi medical matter maano. Kisi trusted insaan ko batao aur hospital ya doctor ke paas jao. Batao ki tumhe spiking ka shak hai, kyunki kuch substances thode time tak hi test mein detect hote hain. Agar sexual contact ka zara bhi chance hai, toh emergency contraception (5 din tak), HIV prevention medicine (72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai) aur infections ki testing ke baare mein poocho. Ho sake toh jo kapde pehne the unhe bina dhoye rakho. Drink spike karna crime hai, chahe kisi ke saath bhi kiya jaye. Nashe ki wajah se consent na de sakne wali woman ke saath sex law mein rape hai; men ke liye law kamzor hai. Police ya 112 par report karo, women 181 par bhi call kar sakti hain. Isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai.

keywords: party ke baad kuch yaad nahi

q.en: My partner took the condom off during sex without telling me. Is that assault, and what should I do?
q.hg: Mere partner ne sex ke dauraan mujhe bataye bina condom utaar diya. Kya yeh assault hai, aur mujhe kya karna chahiye?

a.en: It is a violation of your consent. You agreed to sex with a condom, and that condition was removed without your agreement; this is called stealthing. Indian law does not name it, and how a court would treat it is not settled, so a lawyer or free legal aid on 15100 is the place to ask about a complaint. Your health comes first: emergency contraception works up to 5 days, the sooner the better; ask a doctor urgently about HIV prevention medicine, which must start within 72 hours; and get tested for other infections. Feeling betrayed or shaken is a normal response. 14416 offers support, and women can call 181.
